title: Is Five9 NetSuite Next Ready? United CX in Every View
summary: Is Five9 ready for NetSuite Next? See what stays the same for agents and how to plan your move with the Five9 Adapter for Oracle NetSuite.
body_markdown:
Oracle NetSuite has a new interface, NetSuite Next. If your agents work in NetSuite every day, one question comes up fast. What happens to the tools they rely on?


For Five9 customers, the answer is good news. Five9 is now NetSuite Next Ready. The Five9 Adapter for Oracle NetSuite is compatible with NetSuite Next, Oracle NetSuite's newest interface, so your teams can bring their Five9 experience with them.


### What NetSuite Next Ready means


It means your contact center and your CRM keep working together on the new platform. Agents stay in NetSuite. Existing workflows stay as they are. You won't need to rebuild anything about how your teams handle customers to make the move.


### Every interaction, connected to the customer record


The[Five9 Adapter for Oracle NetSuite](https://www.five9.com/resources/datasheet-five9-adapter-for-oracle-netsuite) combines contact center controls with NetSuite in a single environment. In NetSuite Next, every call, chat, and digital interaction connects to the NetSuite customer record. It doesn't matter how the conversation starts. It lands in the same place.


That gives agents customer history before they engage, so the next conversation starts with context instead of a blank screen. It also gives managers one record that reflects what customers actually experienced.


### Why it matters to your customers


Customers don't care which interface your team uses. They care that you know who they are. When every channel feeds the same record, customers are less likely to repeat themselves, and agents spend less time hunting for information.


That's the difference between handling a contact and delivering an experience. A unified view helps your team respond with the right context, whether the customer called, chatted or reached out digitally.


### Move to NetSuite Next with confidence


A platform change brings plenty of decisions. Your contact center integration should not be one of them. Five9 customers using[Oracle NetSuite](https://www.netsuite.com/portal/company/newsroom/netsuite-next-rollout-begins-ask-oracle-and-new-ai-capabilities-added-to-netsuite.shtml) can plan their move to NetSuite Next knowing the adapter is ready, and that the unified experience their agents rely on comes with them.


The interface is new. The goal is the same: Smarter CX with every interaction.


Ready to talk about your move? Learn about the[Five9 Oracle contact center integration](https://www.five9.com/products/capabilities/crm-integration/oracle-cti-integration) or contact your Five9 account team for a live demo.
